notes: Only executes its body when `unused == 1` (sole call site, NpcUpdateProcessor.method856, always passes 1 - a version/feature-flag literal rather than a decoy in the usual sense, since no other value is ever observed). Reads the per-tick NPC-info packet body from `CircleRasterizer.aClass348_Sub49_Sub2_3813`: first re-adds all still-visible NPCs from the previous tick's list (`Client.anIntArray1233`) that weren't already flagged despawned this tick, then for each previously-visible NPC reads a 1-bit 'has update' flag and, if set, a 2-bit sub-type selecting: (0) simple re-visible + optional minimap-recent flag, (1) re-visible + a 3-bit turn-on-spot direction (`npc.method2443(dir, 1, -10)`) + optional minimap flag, (2) re-visible + either a double 3-bit running-step pair (`method2443(dir, 2, -10)` x2) or a single 3-bit walking step (`method2443(dir, 0, tickOffset)`) + optional minimap flag, or (3) the NPC is not re-added (despawned) and instead recorded into `ProportionalScrollbarComponent.anIntArray9932` (the 'new/changed this tick' list also populated at the top of the method for brand-new spawns). This is the classic RS2 NPC_INFO per-tick movement/despawn decode block, sibling to NpcSpawnDecoder's new-spawn decode.

Returns true iff `mode` is 0, 1, or 2 (matching the three turn/walk/run sub-type codes decoded in method1165), with a side effect of `anInt1949 = 88` when `unused >= -45` - every observed call site (Client.kt) passes bytes in the range -113..-51, all < -45, so that side-effect branch is a dead decoy in every traced case. Heavily used in Client.kt gating camera/redraw/tick logic on `WorldMapRenderer.anInt4674` (a decompiler-misnamed field that behaves like the local scene's current npc/player movement-mode value, not anything world-map related).
